    sandbox.add_joint(support1, support2, (10.0, 5.0), type='pivot',

    # Apply active damping to counteract vibrations

        if abs(body.angularVelocity) > 0.1:
            # Apply torque to counteract rotation
            torque = -body.angularVelocity * 100
            body.ApplyTorque(torque, wake=True)
    
    # Optional: Adjust pivot joint motor speed dynamically
    for joint in sandbox.joints:
        if joint.type == 'pivot':
            joint.motorSpeed = 0.0  # Ensure motor is not actively rotating
